method: Compile an adapter against the unchanged official OpenMVS interface reader; use OpenCV types and nlohmann JSON output.

dependencies.name: OpenMVS Interface.h
dependencies.rights: OpenMVS AGPL-3.0; retained upstream notices and license

dependencies.name: Debian OpenCV development headers
dependencies.rights: OpenCV Apache-2.0 and BSD-3-Clause; Debian component copyright receipt retained

limitations: Native build inputs and raw run assets are ignored; replay requires restoring them from the recorded sources and verified hashes. The retained reports remain inspectable offline.
